utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: It’s still Tuesday at 7 for now, and Vik said he’d bring up the plan at the meeting. I’ll ask around and let Mina know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — Tuesday at 7 still works for now. Let me know what you hear, and I’ll keep coordinating with Dane.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll pass along anything I hear, and it’s still "The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency" for the club right now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, it’s this evening at the community center on Maple Street, and Opal’s coming too. We’re reading "The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency" this month, so come by if you can!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring snacks, and I’m reading the mystery novel with the club this month. Glad Dane and Eli are coming too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks for bringing snacks! It’s great to have you, and if Dane and Eli can make it and there’s room, even better.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—sounds like you all have the book club covered pretty well. What’s still needed, or should I bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re at the community center on Maple Street, and Pia’s still sorting the timing and who’s bringing what. If you want, bring a notepad or I can lend a folding table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring a notepad, and I’m happy to help with the folding table too. Just point me to Pia when you see her.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s Thursday at the cafe. If you want, I can help check the club message and see what you’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — that’d help a lot. I know I’m going to book club, and I’m supposed to bring something, but I keep forgetting what.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check the club message with you and figure out what you’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Has the club picked the next read yet? I’m still waiting on the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m still confirming the details before I say yes. The meeting is in the evening, and I’m checking the place and next time too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet, then? I’m still waiting on the book club details before I can confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Tuesday at 7 at the community center on Maple Street still works for me. I can make it after pickup, and Cleo’s tea sounds perfect.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the tea for sure. And I’ll check in with Gus, Sam, and Nell so we’ve got the rest of the supplies and details covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that sounds great. I’ll plan on Tuesday at 7 at the community center on Maple Street after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you send me the book club details again? I’m checking before I bring my copy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — it’s at the community center on Maple Street, and Quinn is hosting. I’m coming too, and I’ll check the time and let Quinn and Rosa know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — I’ve got Thursday at the cafe from the group notes, so can you confirm whether the community center on Maple Street is the new spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s Thursday at the cafe, so the main thing is just making sure everyone gets the time in case plans need adjusting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Tuesday at 7 still works for me. I’ll check in with Pia on timing and bring Gus the list once Rosa has a few picks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s actually Thursday at the cafe, so Tuesday at 7 won’t work for this one. Let’s keep everyone posted once the time is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m helping with the book club, and Uli’s sending the title again. Oren’s coming too, and Vik will let Jules know it’s a mystery novel.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good — sounds like the mystery’s still the one for this month. Once the club picks the next read, Leo can confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right — we’re still on the mystery this month. Once the next read is picked, I’ll help get the details confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Could you save me a seat at book club? I’d like to make sure I can sit with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — I’ll save you a seat. We meet Tuesday at 7, and we’re reading "The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency" this month.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I appreciate it. I’ll be there Tuesday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Cleo brings tea, and I’ve got some snacks for book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Nice, that should be plenty. I can send the title again if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help—I’ve been a bit distracted and might’ve missed it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Bo said he’s happy to go with one of your light picks, and Cleo’s bringing the tea. Oren’s coming along too, and Kira will keep an eye out for the book club details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put together a few light, discussion-friendly picks and keep everything set for Thursday at the cafe.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds perfect — Thursday at the cafe should be lovely, and I’m sure your picks will get folks talking.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep an eye on what we still need for snacks and supplies. Thanks for handling the details at the meeting.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll bring up the details at the meeting and keep everyone posted. We’re reading a mystery novel this month, so I’m looking forward to that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep tracking snacks and supplies, and with the mystery novel, this should be a fun one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right—Cleo brings tea, and I’ve got some snacks I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks—I’ll ask around and let Mina know if I hear any updates about Tuesday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—thanks, Nell. I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tuesday at 7 still works for me, and I’m fine with whatever book the club picks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thursday at the cafe is the one we’re on now. Cleo has tea and Noah has snacks, so Sam can keep track of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Tuesday at 7 is still the one I have — I’m good with whatever book the club picks.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll fill in the gaps for book club. Once Oren and Leo find the message, I’ll take a look at what’s already there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. The book club is Tuesday at 7, and I’ll be there with my notes handy.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks, Eli — I’ll be ready Tuesday at 7 and bring what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We still haven’t picked the next read, but this month’s mystery is going well. We’re meeting at the community center on Maple Street, and Mina said she’ll bring a copy if the club’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—so the meeting is at the community center on Maple Street this evening, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s right — this evening at the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s currently Tuesday at 7 at the community center on Maple Street, so I can make that after pickup. I’m happy to go with whatever the club decides.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thursday at the cafe is what I have too—can you send the details again so I can confirm before I bring my copy?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I have Tuesday at 7 at the community center on Maple Street—Tess can send the details if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might join late, but I’d love to stop by the book club if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: There’s room, and it’s at the community center on Maple Street. Quinn’s hosting, so come whenever you can — I’ll make sure the time gets to Quinn and Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Opal — I’ll do my best to make it. And good to know Quinn’s hosting; I’ll try not to arrive too late.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—if the book club needs anything, I can bring a notepad or even a folding table. I’ll head over to the community center on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Gus—can you confirm once the club picks the next read? I’m still waiting on the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet—I’ll let you know as soon as they settle on the next read. I’m heading to the community center now, so I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s tonight at the community center on Maple Street, and Opal’s coming too. We’re reading *The No. 1 Ladies’ Detective Agency* this month—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds lovely—yes, please save me a spot! I’m glad to hear Opal’s coming too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll save you a spot. See you tonight at the community center on Maple Street!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s still set for Tuesday at 7, and I’m glad Faye can make it after school pickup. Dane and I will keep planning from there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll send the book club details soon so Kira can keep an eye out. And nice, with Oren coming and Cleo bringing the tea, we’re all set!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — Tuesday at 7 still works, and I’ll keep coordinating with Dane. Thanks for sending the details, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, we’re reading The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency this month. Good thing Sam’s got the snacks and supplies sorted—my memory’s a bit fuzzy these days!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s all set, then — Thursday at the cafe. I can put together a few light, discussion-friendly book picks for us too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be lovely, Rosa — thanks. I’ll bring my notes, and Mina and Opal should be there too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — could you save me a seat at book club? I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll save you a seat at the Quinns tonight. We still haven’t picked the next read, but I can send the title again if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — no need, I remember the title. See you at the Quinns tonight.
